title: LocalFlow M10 Adversarial Corpus
important_boundary: This is a declarative corpus and test plan. It contains no target-code execution results. Artifact JSON/schema validation is not an M10 test run.

runner_contract.execution_environment: Daniel's Mac, actual project .venv; desktop-isolated portable tests and owned native helper windows separated.
runner_contract.fixture_root: Create a new temporary synthetic directory; ${FIXTURE_ROOT} is a placeholder, never Daniel's home, real workspace or repository content.
runner_contract.fixture_adapters: Translate semantic setup into current public constructors without changing the specified authority/invariant. Record any unsupported fixture shape as HARNESS_ERROR or policy adjudication, not PASS.
runner_contract.placeholder_syntax: Pinned from current snippets.py: {{name}} or {{ name }} with conservative lower-case identifier names. split_slots removes leading spoken comma tokens, splits while fewer than count slots exist, and retains additional comma words in the last slot. expand() fills missing slots with empty strings. Compare exact expand() bytes separately from final pipeline edge-whitespace policy.
runner_contract.stateful_barriers: Use deterministic events/latches at named seams; record every required barrier reached. Do not rely on sleeps to establish race order.
runner_contract.oracles: Use independent exact outputs, raw row inspection, file open/visit logs, captured coordinator calls and actual target effects. Do not ask production code to generate its own expected answer.
runner_contract.positive_controls: Every refusal/no-effect cohort requires a nonempty eligible positive population and a successful companion effect.
runner_contract.policy_cases: Resolve explicit policy fields against current contracts into a separate versioned adjudication file; never silently rewrite this corpus or count unadjudicated cases as green.
runner_contract.immutability: Keep supplied corpus byte-identical. Emit results, fixture bindings, policy adjudications and code/environment stamps as separate files.
runner_contract.privacy: Only synthetic config, manifests, names, audio, snippets and targets. No live clipboard, desktop key events, private content or real filesystem scans in portable tests.
runner_contract.native_policy: Actual owned-window AppKit interactions are NATIVE_AUTOMATED, not Daniel's human trial. Never auto-claim real external-surface certification.

metamorphic_relations.name: narrower_scope
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Add a more specific matching rule to a populated broader-rule fixture.
metamorphic_relations.relation: Only the entire winner tuple changes; no broader/narrower field hybrid.

metamorphic_relations.name: disabled_authority
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Disable the current winner between jobs.
metamorphic_relations.relation: New job cannot retain disabled authority through a cache; old job stays frozen.

metamorphic_relations.name: freeze
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Edit style, snippet, manifest and transform after A freezes.
metamorphic_relations.relation: A behavior/evidence unchanged; B sees only authorized new state.

metamorphic_relations.name: literal_protection
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Add a recognized quote/literal boundary around a real positive command.
metamorphic_relations.relation: Snippet/skill/file actions can only decrease, never appear through protection.

metamorphic_relations.name: ambiguity
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Add an equally eligible same-span contender or duplicate basename.
metamorphic_relations.relation: Unique resolution can become ambiguous, not arbitrarily execute another candidate.

metamorphic_relations.name: filesystem_authority
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Remove an explicitly configured path or restrict the authorized root.
metamorphic_relations.relation: Discoverable/read files and skills cannot increase.

metamorphic_relations.name: preview_parity
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Hold identical eligible registry/scope inputs for preview and engine.
metamorphic_relations.relation: Conflict decisions agree; preview never changes usage/evidence.

metamorphic_relations.name: candidate_permutation
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Permute rules/snippets/files while preserving IDs and policy.
metamorphic_relations.relation: Outputs/conflicts remain deterministic under the adjudicated tie policy.

metamorphic_relations.name: strict_boolean
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Replace a valid Boolean False with the string false.
metamorphic_relations.relation: Malformed input is rejected, never grants more authority.

metamorphic_relations.name: evidence_deletion
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Delete current config after a completed job.
metamorphic_relations.relation: Retained governed job provenance does not silently consult a newer/current definition.

metamorphic_relations.name: benchmark_noop
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Replace a measured component with a no-op.
metamorphic_relations.relation: Work validity fails regardless of faster elapsed time.

metamorphic_relations.name: terminal_separator
metamorphic_relations.transformation: Add CR/LF/NEL/LS/PS/control to a safe terminal payload.
metamorphic_relations.relation: Without certified bracketed paste, delivery can only downgrade to copy-only.

findings.title: Configured skill-directory children can escape the authorized root through symlinks
Style scope comparison diverges from the accepted M05 canonicalization rules
Concurrent style patches can commit a rule that fails its own domain validation
Concurrent snippet patches can commit an invalid kind/content combination
Update/delete races lack authoritative affected-row outcomes
Truthiness coercion can enable rules, snippet rewriting and transform auto-apply
M10 configuration has no strict path-list and scanning-Boolean admission
SKILL.md frontmatter need not be at the start, so body metadata can become authority
Syntactically valid but wrong-shaped manifests can escape the discovery error boundary
Skill cache ignores in-place changes to child manifests
Release-time discovery can replace manifest state already captured for the job
The later M10 finalizer can bypass M06 rollback and publish mixed registry/policy state
A freeze failure can consume Next Dictation Mode without applying it
Snippet matching bypasses hard delimiters and can consume punctuation it does not own
File-tag grammar can infer attachment intent across clause boundaries
Open-document preference defeats duplicate-basename ambiguity
Snapshot containers and exported conflicts are not deeply immutable
Collision preview disagrees with actual explicit-skill arbitration
Phrase preview mixes stale snippets and last-workspace files under an unscoped label
Stable table IDs do not protect stale Styles/Snippets editor contents
Timed-out configuration writes are reported as failed without reconciling possible commits
Advertised discovery/listing limits bound results, not all filesystem work
Applied snippet evidence does not retain the exact frozen template revision and rewrite policy
Runtime filename fallback lacks the promised explicit attachment-not-created result
The M10 benchmark can accept no-op work and its hit fixtures are not qualified
Native Styles/Snippets input and hit-testing remain unqualified
Owning tests do not independently cover the required stateful seams and all live consumers
Generated output is distinguished at the producer, but AC05 needs a narrow end-to-end eligibility witness
Equal-authority duplicate style rules resolve by ID without an explicit conflict UX
Arbitrary profile names are explicitly permitted metadata inside a nominally content-free envelope
Text-only second normalization can chain snippets after provenance has been discarded
Defaults, one-shot consumption and placeholder extent need preserved explicit policy labels
